name: Flywheel
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on April 1st, 2021.
This paint could have been obtained in the exotic tier of Ultra Containers.
Though the flywheels in this paint don't actually give your tank extra momentum, they may mesmerize your enemies long enough for you to make an escape.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
